name: Users can switch between their roles
expected: Selecting a different role correctly switches the assigned role

name: Users can be assigned different DAGs for each role
expected: Custom DAG assignments are saved, or revert to standard role assignments if custom DAGs are removed

name: Custom DAG assignments are enacted when the user changes role
expected: After changing role, the user has the DAGs for that role

name: System administrators can deactivate/reactivate their full access privilege
expected: Administrators can temporarily deactivate their full access, so the roles work as intended. This is not available to standard users. All deactivated admin rights are restored if an admin goes to configure admins in the control centre.
